text_block_list.text:
Having arrived at the shrine, we 
immediately set out to offer our prayers, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, are you ready!? Then let's enjoy 
this to our heart's content—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please exorcise me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, truth is, I haven't been feeling so 
great lately. And then, Lady Shiraoki 
appeared in my dream last night...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Have your fated person exorcise the evil 
spirits from you. Only then shall the path 
open"... That was the oracle!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So please! I beg of you!! O Great Deity 
Trainer-samaaa~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yay!! That's my Trainer for ya! You're the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, please repeat after me! Here we 
gooo~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Squishy paw pads!! Nyaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ohh... ohh... oooohhhhhh~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fuku-chan... re☆born~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Doesn't my aura feel 
completely transformed?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What a relief! Now I can finally say 
goodbye to living in fear of bad omens! 
And besides...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Gfufu! Trainer saying 'meow'... 
gfufufufu!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's so interesting, I could listen to it 
over and over—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!! By the way, aren't you hungry, 
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Exorcising evil spirits really builds up 
an appetite~! Alright, time to head home!! 
Yup!!

There are plenty of things to ponder, but 
Matikanefukukitaru seems to have cheered 
up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nya? Nya-nya...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nya!?!? Nyaaa!?!?

Matikane Fukukitaru is desperately 
pleading with her eyes...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nya! Nya-nya-nya!! (The spirit haunting me 
must have been a cat!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nya-nya, nya, nyaa! (So it got mad at the 
exorcism... and took full possession!)

It seems the evil spirit was angered and 
showed itself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nyaaaaaan!! (Waaah! What should I doooo?!)

Afterward, I desperately tried to calm her 
down and somehow managed to get her speech 
back to normal... but her slump remained 
unaddressed.
